welcome.highlights.filesystem.title: Filesystem only
welcome.highlights.filesystem.desc: Collections are plain files on your disk. No cloud sync, no proprietary lock-in.
welcome.highlights.git.title: Git-friendly
welcome.highlights.git.desc: Every request is a readable file. Commit, branch, review, and collaborate using the tools you already know.
welcome.highlights.privacy.title: Privacy-focused
welcome.highlights.privacy.desc: No account, no login. Bruno works entirely offline, your API keys never leave your machine.
welcome.highlights.fast.title: Fast and lightweight
welcome.highlights.fast.desc: Built to be snappy. No bloated runtimes, just a fast, focused tool for exploring and testing APIs.
